newsitem.title: USA: Medtronic, Orphan Medical in joint drug trial.
newsitem.headline: Medtronic, Orphan Medical in joint drug trial.

text.p: Medtronic Inc and Orphan Medical Inc said they will collaborate on a system that delivers a pain-relieving drug directly into spinal fluid.

The so-called SynchroMed system delivers the drug clonidine into the sheath that surrounds the spinal cord. Medtronic and Orphan Medical believe the system may be effective in patients whose chronic pain is no longer affected by morphine or other pain relief systems.
The companies said they plan to begin clinical trials of the SynchroMed system in 1997.
Medtronic specializes in implantable medical technologies. Orphan Medical focuses on patients with inadequately treated or uncommon diseases.
Medtronic shares closed Monday at 62, off 1/2, while Orphan Medical shares closed at 9-7/8, off 1/4.
